## What does this change?

- [ ] Update my personal page (`people/<my-name>/`)
- [ ] Add news / event / publication
- [ ] Site-wide change (layout, styles, navigation)

## Checklist

- [ ] I only edited files inside my own folder (for personal-page updates)
- [ ] Images are under 500 KB
- [ ] I previewed the page locally (opened the HTML file in a browser)
